locations.name: City of Surrey Truck Parking (17768 96 Avenue)
locations.source_note: City of Surrey commercial truck parking site at 17768 96 Avenue (Anniedale-Tynehead), Hwy 15 / Pacific Highway corridor. City news and corporate reports advance this City-owned lot (~41 truck spaces) under Temporary Use Permit / licence with Prudential Transportation. Pin matches the Phase A Surrey stand-in coordinates.
